name: DISABLE LOCATION ACCESS
description: Prevents apps from accessing your device location.
check: powershell -NoProfile -Command "try { $v = (Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\CapabilityAccessManager\ConsentStore\location' -Name 'Value' -ErrorAction Stop).Value; if ($v -eq 'Deny') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 } } catch { exit 1 }"
